name: asem-refine-benchmarks
description: Benchmark snapshot accompanying the revised manuscript. Added since v1.2.0: Full 720-job MIA and Pilon grids (30 ordered pairs, 1-8X, three replicates). Strand- and circular-origin-normalized rescoring of every successful NOVOPlasty (591) and GetOrganelle (198) job, with retained assemblies. Supplementary verified same-genus pair (Macaca silenus / M. tonkeana) for all eight methods (ASEM_PAIR_SET=macaca_same_genus). Mixed-orientation test of ASEM and ASEM-Hybrid. Secondary-placement check for the hardest pair. Scripts that draw every manuscript data figure and the worked-example figure (scripts/manuscript_figures/). grid_run_guard.py, required by run_grid_ext_novoplasty.py but missing from v1.2.0. NOVOPLASTY_TIMEOUT_S option; English installation and execution guide.
